$meta.name: Modus One — Deep Field
$meta.note: The single source of truth for Modus One colour. dist/modus-one.css and dist/tokens.js are generated from this file by `npm run build`. Edit here, never there.
$meta.contrastNote: Every text token clears WCAG AA (4.5:1) on its own ground. Measured minimum across the system is 4.90:1 — accent on light bg, which is only ever used at 46px numerals and for rules and focus rings, where the requirement is 3:1.
$meta.signalNote: positive/negative exist for apps that must colour a figure by its meaning. They are never decoration, never a headline, and never the only cue — pair them with a sign, a word or a position.
$meta.motionNote: Two kinds of change, two tokens (PATTERNS.md §15). spatial is a spring for position, size and shape, and must settle without overshoot: npm test fails if it bounces. effects is a short fade for colour and opacity, never a spring. The CSS easing and duration for spatial are generated from the spring by the build; never hand-write them.

accent.job: Terracotta — STRUCTURE: numerals, rules, discs, focus rings

accent2.job: LABELS ONLY — mono eyebrows and kickers, never above 13px

spark.job: Mint — THE VOICE: the one italic accent phrase, and the lens dot

positive.job: SIGNAL — money in, paid, repayable, confirmed. Figures and status only; shares spark's hue on purpose so no new colour enters the palette

negative.job: SIGNAL — money out, owed, overdue, payable, needs attention. Figures and status only; shares accent's hue on purpose so no new colour enters the palette

accent.job: ITALIC ONLY — one accent phrase per headline, and numerals

mono.stack: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

spatial.job: Position, size, shape. A spring with no overshoot; carries velocity when interrupted

effects.job: Colour and opacity only. Never a spring

reduced.job: Under prefers-reduced-motion, movement becomes this fade

$meta.name: Modus One — Horizon
$meta.note: The consumer theme. Deep Field (the top-level color/font/size/motion in this file) stays the corporate theme. Horizon is light by default: Paper is its light mode, Forest its dark. Generated into dist/horizon.css as --hz-* custom properties.
$meta.colourNote: Two colours carry meaning and nothing else does. lead = you can press it, you are on it, or it is done. signal = it needs you. Everything else is ink on ground, with cards in surface.
$meta.motionNote: Horizon moves with a slight overshoot. npm test fails if the spring does not overshoot at all or overshoots by more than 6%.

soft.job: Secondary text; the second clause of a headline

lead.job: LEAD — main action, current tab, today, links, done. Never decoration

signal.job: SIGNAL — overdue markers and bars. Non-text only in light mode (3:1)

signalText.job: SIGNAL — wording on ground or surface

signalFill.job: SIGNAL — the fill of a "needs you" card

display.job: Display and body. Display is sentence case, 800, and ends with a full stop

mono.stack: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

spatial.job: Position, size, shape. A spring with a slight overshoot; carries velocity when interrupted

effects.job: Colour and opacity only. Never a spring

reduced.job: Under prefers-reduced-motion, movement becomes this fade

logo.job: The Modus One lens, unchanged in geometry. Ring in ink at stroke 3 (Deep Field uses 2), dot in lead. Wordmark: Bricolage Grotesque, lower case, modus at 500 and one at 800, tracking -0.03em
